about.title: about me
about.intro: Software engineer with a front-end focus — {years} years of React and more, from start to finish. Mechatronics came earlier and left behind: 3D printer, hardware tinkering, and an obsession with how things fit together. Recently exploring agent-based AI. Ideas: plenty, but time isn't stretchy.

experience.description: Built MVP for a financial app using React and Next.js.
Developed React front-end for a job-search platform, technical tools, and a social media content management site.
Front-end across WordPress, jQuery, React, Vue, Twig. Scrum, strong team, numerous deployments.

education.description: Masters in Mechatronics (uncompleted). Life was just too interesting.
